_justification: Approved vendor-runtime scan exclusions for the binaries with missing PDBs in build 363065. Applied only to these exact filenames directly in the CLI publish root. This follows classic PowerShell's explicit file-exclusion approach, but the .NET runtime list is azclips-specific. Excluded files receive no BinSkim checks; review this list when runtime dependencies change.
_patternsJustification: The .NET diagnostics DAC file name embeds the runtime build (mscordaccore_<arch>_<arch>_<version>.dll) and its PDB is not shipped, so exact names break on every runtime update (ERR997 in builds 363065 and 366583). Patterns are limited to the version segment of root-level files and are validated by get_binskim_cli_targets.ps1.
